faq.question: Who is Akhil Mishra in Rewa cricket?
faq.answer: Akhil Mishra is the franchise captain and lead top-order batsman of Dread Eleven Cricket Club (DE). He captained Dread Eleven to the 2022 Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Tournament championship.

faq.question: What are Akhil Mishra's career batting and bowling statistics?
faq.answer: 1,378 runs at 44.5 average (SR 130.0, HS 96*, 12 fifties, 1 hundred) and 38 wickets with best bowling figures of 4/28.

faq.question: What is Akhil Mishra's captaincy record against Destroyers?
faq.answer: 15 wins, leading Dread Eleven to the 2022 tournament title.
